messages:
elaine-marketing: Heads-up — BrightCart case study: customer interview scheduled. Need quotes, legal ok, design assets, and a webinar plan. Target launch week Apr 14. Who's on deck?
joseph-csm: I can run the interview with BrightCart on Tues 4/8 at 10am PT. They'll share metrics and a short demo. @claire-content can you do questions?
claire-content: Yep. I'll draft Qs tonight and send to @joseph-csm for review. Want a hero quote and a one-paragraph blurb from their CTO.
zoe-legal: Please share the customer-provided quote text before publishing. Also need to send the case study to legal for a quick compliance check — 24-48h turnaround.
elaine-marketing: Noted. @joseph-csm please get written approval for quotes during the interview or via email.
joseph-csm: Will ask for signed approval (email OK). Also confirming they can appear in a webinar on Thu 4/17.
mike-sales: Sales wants a short one-pager we can use in demos — can design deliver a 1-slide summary?
sam-design: Yes — I'll mock a hero slide + KPI callouts. Need the final metrics and screenshots by 4/10 EOD.
arjun-pm: Can product provide a 2-min clip of the integration to be used in the webinar? @mike-sales @joseph-csm
lina-growth: I'll set up the webinar page / registration flow once we have the date. Also running paid ads after the case study is live.
claire-content: Draft Qs attached:
```
1) Can you briefly describe the problem BrightCart was solving?
2) What alternatives did you consider and why choose Redwood?
3) Can you share specific metrics or outcomes since adopting Redwood (latency, cost, throughput)?
4) Any notable deployment or security requirements we should highlight?
5) Can we quote a short sentence from the CTO about developer velocity or cost savings?
```
elaine-marketing: Legal draft acceptance: @zoe-legal what's your deadline for final approval?
zoe-legal: If quotes are submitted by 4/11 noon PT, we can approve by 4/13 EOD. Any changes after that push timeline.
joseph-csm: Got it, will aim for written quote by 4/11. Quick ask: can marketing prepare a short pre-release copy for customer review?
claire-content: I'll produce 3 headline options + 150-word draft by 4/9.
sam-design: :thumbsup: will pair with Claire to finalize hero image.
marketing-bot: Reminder: add case-study tag to content calendar and create a Slack reminder for 4/10.
elaine-marketing: PR/Legal: any branded terms to avoid? @zoe-legal
zoe-legal: Don't use any financial numbers that are not in customer's approval email. Otherwise fine.
mike-sales: If webinar needs a customer speaker, I'll prep talking points and do a dry run with them 4/15.
elaine-marketing: Next steps summary:
- Interview 4/8 @10am PT (Joseph)
- Draft copy by 4/9 (Claire)
- Metrics/screenshots to design by 4/10 (Joseph + Product)
- Quotes to legal by 4/11
- Final legal ok by 4/13
- Webinar 4/17 — dry run 4/15
I'll create a checklist and share.
joseph-csm: Thanks — adding to my calendar. I'll upload recording + approved quote to this thread once done.
